مُحَكِّمٌ , and its pl. مُحَكِّمُونَ: see مُحَكَّمٌ. ―
-b2- المُحَكِّمَةُ is an appellation applied to the [schismatics called the] خَوَارِج because they disallowed the judgment of the ↓ حَكَمَانِ [or two judges], (S,) namely, Aboo-Moosà El-Ash'aree and 'Amr Ibn-El-' Ás, (K, TA,) and said that judgment الحُكْمُ) belongs not to any but God. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
